title: MotionGlot: A Multi-Embodied Motion Generation Model

live_model.evidence: 'we prompt gpt-4-turbo to rewrite 23000 prompts from'

prompt.note: The rewriting instruction itself is not quoted.

claim.metric: none for gpt-4-turbo itself (it is used to augment/rewrite the text-prompt corpus used to train/evaluate the paper's own MotionGlot model, which is what the reported motion-generation metrics describe)

data.source: Motion-language datasets (e.g. HumanML3D-style) with 23,000 prompts rewritten by gpt-4-turbo

notes: gpt-4-turbo is a role-A data-augmentation utility (prompt rewriting), not the subject of MotionGlot's reported motion-generation benchmarks.
